verdict.line: Walk away above $2,590 psf. A 3-bed here at about $2,600 to $2,800 psf is 9% above what the closest competitors' 3-bed-size resales support (about $2,470 psf as a new launch). Buy only at or below about $2,470 psf. 3-bed and 4-bed are the most wanted sizes in this mixed own-stay and rental area.
reasons: The closest competitors (The Glades, Grandeur Park Residences, Optima @ Tanah Merah, Eco, Urban Vista) work out to about $2,470 psf as a brand-new launch, after adding 5% where they were not built under the harmonised floor-area rules, a 33% new-launch premium (what launches selling now in the OCR charge over their closest resale, 13 launches).

The Glades (104 m away, 726 homes, completed 2016): its 3-bed-size resales (about 810 to 1,100 sq ft) averaged $1,816 psf over the last 6 months (7 resales), against a median $1,739 psf for all sizes. A 3-bed here at about $2,700 psf is $885 psf (+49%) above that; a 3-bed there sold for a median $1.83M.

The newest land bid nearby, New Upper Changi Road (GLS) (1,983 m, $1,537 psf ppr), is 16% above this site's land cost. It breaks even at about $2,540 psf, and is likely to launch at about $3,230 psf (break-even plus the 27% that launches since 2023 priced above theirs).

compsNote: 5 of the 5 competitors are within 1 km. Near-twins come first: up to two condos within 1.5 km with a similar number of homes (half to double) completed in 2016 or later. Then every suitable condo within 1 km (same tenure, completed 2011 or later first), widening to 2 km and 3 km only if fewer than 3; executive condos are left out. Resale prices are URA medians for the last 6 months where there were at least 5 resales, otherwise the last 12 months. Condos launched before June 2023 measured their areas under the old rules (including air-con ledges), so their psf is raised 5% to compare like for like.
priceDecide: Like for like by size: for each unit type we take each resale competitor's average psf for units within about 15% of that size (last 6 months, or 12 or 24 if too few). Each is raised by the 33% new-launch premium that launches selling now in the OCR carry over their closest resale (13 launches). Buy at or below = the average of the competitors' new-launch equivalents for that size; walk away above = 5% more. 2-bed: buy at or below $2,390, walk away above $2,510, this project about $2,751 psf; 3-bed: buy at or below $2,470, walk away above $2,590, this project about $2,700 psf; 4-bed: buy at or below $2,320, walk away above $2,440, this project about $2,664 psf. This project's price by unit type follows how psf changes with size among the competitors (smaller units usually cost more per sq ft).  The developer breaks even at about $2,260 psf (EdgeProp's method); launches since 2023 priced on average 27% above break-even, which points to about $2,870 psf.

gain.timeline: Buy at an estimated 2027 launch (some material says the second half). No completion date is published; we assume TOP around 2031. Seller's Stamp Duty applies for 4 years, so we test a sale in 2032 (5 years), and also 6 years.
gain.costs: Potential gain is after Buyer's Stamp Duty at IRAS rates, about $6,000 legal fees and a 2% agent fee plus 9% GST when you sell. Loan interest, property tax, maintenance and rent are not included.

exit.note: How we test each buyer group, in today's money (prices, HDB values and incomes tend to rise together): the unit at today's tested price; a 25% down payment plus Buyer's Stamp Duty; HDB upgraders put their flat's sale proceeds in first (median resale price, minus an illustrative $150,000 loan). The group can buy if that capital covers the down payment and stamp duty; the income the remaining 30-year loan needs (tested at 4% under the 55% TDSR) is shown against SingStat's 2025 averages by home type, excluding employer CPF (4-room $11,097, 5-room and executive $13,887, condo $22,006). HDB resale prices rose 4.2% a year over the past 10 years, so upgraders' capital usually grows too. Singaporean HDB owners who buy before selling pay 20% Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty upfront and get it back only if they sell the flat within 6 months (IRAS).
exit.line: In this mixed own-stay and rental area, the 2-bed resale pool is wide; the 3-bed resale pool is good; the 4-bed resale pool is good.

fplans.note: Main layout per bedroom type (most units where counts are published), redrawn from the developers' plans in the Stacked Homes directory. Score out of 10, same rules for every plan: start at 4; +1 regular shape, dumbbell, kitchen that can be closed off, kitchen or yard window, AC ledge and planter under 5%, store or shelter or utility room; −1 long corridor, ledge and planter 10% or more, balcony over 12%.
